_readme: Starter benchmark. Grow it to ~120 questions. For each answerable question, open the filing, find the passage, and fill in gold (where the answer lives) and expected_numbers (figures the answer must contain, written as in the filing, e.g. "$8,675 million"). Leave fiscal_year out of gold to accept any year.

questions.question: What supply chain risks does Apple describe?
How does JPMorgan Chase describe its cybersecurity risks?
Who does Netflix say it competes with?
What risks does Tesla describe about battery cell suppliers?
What was NVIDIA's research and development expense in its most recent fiscal year?
questions.todo: Look up the figure in the latest NVIDIA 10-K and add it to expected_numbers.
